mod.slabbed.name: Slabbed
slabbed.settings.title: Slabbed Settings
slabbed.settings.pot_seat.flush.tooltip: Flower pots sit right on the surface you can see, with no gap. This only changes pots you place from now on.
Flower pots keep the small gap vanilla leaves above the surface. This only changes pots you place from now on, and on a server it is the server's setting that decides.
slabbed.report.explanation: Write a short report, then review exactly what will be included before opening GitHub. You submit the issue yourself.
slabbed.report.versions: Client version context (server versions are not collected):
slabbed.report.privacy: Only your report text, client version context, and any client mod IDs and versions you explicitly choose are included. Opening a prefilled link sends its text to GitHub before you submit.
slabbed.report.ready: Review the exact text above. Cancel or Escape closes without sending anything.
slabbed.report.requested: Browser opening requested with the reviewed text in the link. Slabbed has not submitted an issue. If the browser did not open, copy the report link or text.
slabbed.report.failed: The browser could not be opened. Copy the report text or link and open github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/new yourself.
slabbed.report.draft_explanation: Describe the problem below. You will review the full report before anything is sent to GitHub.
slabbed.report.title_hint: For example: Glass floats above a slab
slabbed.report.steps_hint: Tell me the steps or what you were doing.
slabbed.report.happened_hint: Describe what went wrong and what you expected.
slabbed.report.mods_scope: Only IDs and versions loaded on this client are read when you turn this on. Mod IDs can identify private or unreleased mods. You can edit or remove them before opening GitHub. Server-only mods, packs, shaders, settings and logs are not collected.
slabbed.report.mods_edit: Included client mods: edit or delete any lines (one ID and version per line).
slabbed.report.omitted: %s invalid, repeated or oversized mod entries were omitted. The preview will mark the list as incomplete.
slabbed.report.required: Add a title and both descriptions, then choose where this happened.
slabbed.report.public_notice: Destination: GitHub (peetsamods/slabbed). Opening a prefilled link sends the reviewed text below to GitHub before you post. A submitted issue is public. Edit the report or remove its mod list now if needed.
slabbed.report.long_notice: This report is too long for a prefilled link. Copy report text, then open a blank GitHub issue (peetsamods/slabbed) and paste it. The blank link sends no report text. A submitted issue is public.
slabbed.report.blank_requested: Blank GitHub issue requested; no report text was included in that link. Paste the copied report yourself. Slabbed has not submitted anything.
